entities.summary: Jaime Ignacio del Burgo Tajadura Doctor in Law from the University of Deusto, he is a jurist, historian and politician from Navarra, which is a Foral or autonomous Community, integrated into the Kingdom of Spain. In 1977 he was elected Senator and had an active participation in the drafting of the Spanish Constitution of 1978. In 1979 he was elected member of the Parliament of Navarra, provincial deputy for the city of Pamplona and president of the first Provincial Council or Government of Navarra.
